text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Enriched blend's mean absolute error minus the enriched best single product's, main XGBoost settings. The best single product is CAMS for the solar blends holding CAMS, ICON-D2 for the four weather models, and UKV for wind. The splits share hours and XGBoost models, so they are not independent tests. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to September 2026. All rows are exploratory.'
